knowledge_time_rule: An explicit API publishDate is retained as source_publication_time where recovered; otherwise the displayed header has no independently verified timezone. settlement_rule: automatic_settlement is its announced start, followed by delisting after completion; it is not a measured delisting-completion timestamp.
terms_rule: Terms attached to a launch describe that launch only. No assertion that tick sizes, margin, fees or funding intervals remained unchanged.
universe_rule: All 73 missing-snapshot names stay listed below. Names from the 698 snapshot rows that share a notice are retained too. Absence of a notice does not prove absence of an event; a partial notice set does not prove continuous trading.
